rca of the issue: Iter 43 issues all root-caused to two bugs in ContributionEstimator.jsx — (a) no mount-time fetch of participant doc so pension_status stayed at default 'full', and (b) re-run gated on prior `result`. Both fixed in iter 44 by adding useEffect mount-fetch calling _applyParticipantToForm and changing onParticipantUpdated to unconditionally trigger submit() via {rerun:true}. The 'missing trail-line on input rows' issue from iter43 was a downstream symptom — once mount-hydrate exposed the rate input AND the save path actually fired (which depends on the inline-prompt input being visible), the trail line rendered correctly. The trail-line render itself was always correct in PromptRow — the user just couldn't reach the save action because the input was hidden when pension_status='full'.
